scripts.dev: npm run build -w @novel-studio/contracts && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @novel-studio/server" "npm run dev -w @novel-studio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @novel-studio/contracts && npm run build -w @novel-studio/web && npm run build -w @novel-studio/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @novel-studio/server && npm run test -w @novel-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @novel-studio/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @novel-studio/server && npm run typecheck -w @novel-studio/web
